items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Was that his own band or somebody like Pierone or? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I think that was just a group of men he got together.

ctx.x: And I'm trying to think of the artists. He, he played the Steamer Capitol. Oh, yes.
Do you remember whose band that was? Was that his own band or somebody like Pierone or?
No, I think that was just a group of men he got together. Mm-hmm. And, you know, they played in other words. The Steamer Capitol. He was the leader of that band. Yes. But there was no name to it.
